name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Suggestion
powers.text: While scrying, cast Suggestion (save DC 17) through the sensor once per dawn.

summary: Cast Scrying (save DC 17) through it. Plus more.
text: This crystal globe is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. While scrying with it, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the sensor, and once per dawn cast Suggestion (save DC 17) through it.
